rules: Territorial loss does not by itself erase civilization identity.
Political fragmentation may create multiple polities without automatically creating multiple civilizations.
A true civilization split creates successor IDs with predecessor lineage and never deletes predecessor history.
A merger/integration records predecessor IDs; whether one identity continues or a new composite ID is created must be explicit.
Extinction requires causal evidence and an append-only extinction event.
Extinct civilizations remain addressable historical entities for archaeology, records and descendants.
Later rediscovery cannot reroll extinct civilization facts.

future_dependencies.block_3: War may cause fragmentation/extinction but cannot bypass lineage.
future_dependencies.block_5: Generated pre-campaign history must respect lineage.
